claims.evidence: Witness report says TV brand/model text is not clearly readable; only webOS interface is visible.
Witness report does not show screen size (in inches) or any readable size/model markings.
Model number is not readable in the witness photos.
Photos show webOS home screen but do not confirm resolution (HD/Full HD/4K) or panel specs.
Witness only reports webOS home screen; no clear evidence of specific AI features from the photos.

risks.risk: Screen defects not visible from the angles shown (dead pixels, scratches, backlight faults, burn-in).
risks.proof: A close-up video while scrolling on a pure white/black/gray test pattern (or YouTube dead-pixel test) plus a full-screen brightness sweep, filmed straight-on and from corners.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: screen may have hidden defects; treat as higher risk for returns.

risks.risk: Resolution/spec mismatch (not actually 4K, or different model than claimed).
risks.proof: Photo of the TV label/spec sticker (back or side) showing exact model and resolution, and a screenshot from Settings → Picture/Info showing resolution.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: unknown resolution/model; value reduced versus claimed 4K 86-inch.

risks.risk: Audio/speaker issues and port/input faults (HDMI/USB/antenna) not testable from the photos.
risks.proof: Short clip showing HDMI input working (e.g., YouTube on HDMI) and a volume test, plus a shot of all ports with a connected HDMI/USB device displaying content.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: inputs may be faulty; assume limited functionality.

risks.risk: Remote control missing or not working; setup may be incomplete.
risks.proof: Photo of the remote (front/back) and a quick clip showing remote buttons controlling the webOS cursor.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: remote not included/unknown condition.

risks.risk: Wall-mount/stand completeness and mounting hardware not included (risk for buyer installation).
risks.proof: Photo showing included stand/wall-mount bracket hardware and all accessories in one frame (brackets, screws, manual).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: mounting/stand hardware may be missing.

risks.risk: External box/set-top box condition and whether it’s included/working (witness only says a small external device is present).
risks.proof: Video clip powering the external box and showing it outputting to the TV (clear on-screen menu), plus a photo of its model label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: external device may be non-included or unreliable.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the TV back/side label showing exact brand, model number, and screen size.
Screenshot/photo from TV Settings → About/Information showing resolution (UHD 4K) and model details.
Video test for dead pixels/backlight: show black/white/gray screens and a brightness sweep.
Clip demonstrating HDMI/USB input working (play a video) and a quick audio/volume test.
Photo and working video of the remote control (cursor movement on webOS).
Photos of included accessories: stand/wall-mount brackets and all screws/manuals (if any).
Photo/video of the external box/set-top device with its model label and proof it works.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a large LG webOS smart TV that is powered on, but key pricing drivers (exact size/model and confirmed 4K resolution) are not readable in the report. Without those, a worst-case price would be too uncertain; request the label/spec and a resolution proof shot/video.
